title: [gcloud] `GS_FILE_OVERWRITE = False` can still overwrite files through concurrent saves
author: maxhowald
body_preview: With `GS_FILE_OVERWRITE = False`, `GoogleCloudStorage` avoids replacing an existing object through `get_available_name()`, which calls `exists()` and appends a random suffix when the name is taken. title: Add an opt-in bounded streaming-read API for remote storage backends
author: dralley
